scope: Every item from the three prior audits, re-checked against the working tree as it is on this date. This register establishes truth and takes no action on any finding.

verdict_vocabulary.closed: Re-checked. The defect no longer exists in current source; the remediation is present and locatable.
verdict_vocabulary.still-open: Re-checked. The defect still exists, and no prior remediation was ever recorded against it. Carry forward unchanged.
verdict_vocabulary.open: Re-checked. The defect still exists AND its state changed since the original audit wrote it (partly remediated, cited file moved or deleted, or a new doc/code disagreement found). Needs re-prioritising, not blind re-fixing.
verdict_vocabulary.superseded: Re-checked. The finding's premise was decided against by a later authoritative decision. Do not action the original text.

maintenance: Append-only. Never renumber, reorder, or delete an existing ID. Close an item by recording closure evidence. New findings append with fresh IDs in a fresh namespace.

The two namespaces collided on R01-R07, so every ID here is namespaced: PHASE0/F-nn, WS/Snn, WS/Rnn, WS/Vnn, WS/CEnn, CE/nn, DRV-nn. WS/CE01 is the web-surface Creator-Edition item; CE/01 is the performance/UX finding 1. They are different things.
